I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell.

Two sources back this up, and Marcus can see both. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 (morning shift). The public North cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact, as Director of Yard Operations.
